description: 臺灣鐵路 [railways and stations] is a dataset listed in Government Open Data Platform of Taiwan (data.gov.tw), an open data portal, published or maintained by 內政部國土測繪中心. 為整合政府資源，自106年度起將交通部「交通路網數值圖」併入本中心「臺灣通用電子地圖」更新，依據雙方共同訂定之圖層架構建置「臺灣地區交通路網圖數值資料檔」，並歸類歸類為臺灣通用電子地圖主題圖層之一。 另為配合政府推動資料開放政策(Open Data)，本中心開放「臺灣地區交通路網數值圖資料檔」部分圖資提供大眾瀏覽使用，促使跨機關資料流通，... Coverage: Taiwan. The portal files it under the publisher 內政部國土測繪中心. Its tags are 交通及通訊. It offers 1 resource(s) in zip. The portal shows 2026-04-24 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Chinese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is 政府資料開放授權條款-第1版. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support rail network and station studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-tw-dgt-portal.
